==Description==
'''Sacred Mountains''' is a [[Maps|map]] that takes place atop a group of mountain peaks.

==Design & Path==
'''Sacred Mountains''' takes place in a mountainous area of high altitude. A majority of the area is covered in lush greenery which includes grass, trees, and vines. Rocks can also be seen scattered across the map.

The path starts at a cave and ends at a structure on the top of a mountain. The path crosses cobblestone bridges over gaps.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Sacred Mountains}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Hard|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*It is recommended to put towers on the first or second curve due to the map's short length.
**Due to most towers not having enough range to reach over the entire curve in the early game, the [[DJ Booth]] can be helpful in making towers see the entire curve. 
*Cliff spots in this map are quite limited, so bringing cliff towers such as the [[Sniper]] are not recommended.
*The second curve is slightly wider than the first one, though it is farther from the entrance.

==Trivia==
*On 7th of March 2022, this alongside [[Grass Isle]], [[Crystal Cave]] and [[Wrecked Battlefield]] were accidentally left as the only survival maps in the game. It was unplayable, as the game would never load the map.
**'''Sacred Mountains''' used the [[Grass Isle]] icon and difficulty.
**This was later fixed on the same day.
*On the back of one of the mountains, a humanoid can be seen sitting on it, while fishing in the fog.
*'''Sacred Mountains''' was made around 2021.
